name: button
title: Button
description: Fluent 2's Button: primary, secondary, outline, subtle and transparent appearances (plus Byterygon's danger) in small, medium and large, with hover, pressed, focus (the double ring), disabled and loading states.
usage: Use one primary Button per view for the main action, secondary for the others, outline where an edge without a fill reads better, subtle in toolbars and dense rows, transparent for a link-like action, danger for one that destroys data. Medium is the default size; small in dense rows, large for a main call to action. Give it a visible text label (an Icon from @/lib/icons may go before it); for an icon alone use IconButton. Set loading while the action runs instead of disabling it, and type="submit" inside a form. The old variant prop (ghost is subtle) and the sm/md/lg sizes still work for one release.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Fluent's appearance. One primary action per view; secondary for the others; subtle in toolbars; danger (Byterygon's) for actions that destroy data.

props.name: size
props.description: Fluent's sizes: 24, 32 and 40 px when comfortable, 22, 28 and 34 px when compact (size.control.sm, md, lg).

props.name: variant
props.description: The old name of appearance; ghost maps to subtle. Kept for one release.

props.name: size (sm, md, lg)
props.description: The old size names, mapped to small, medium and large. Kept for one release.

props.name: loading
props.description: The action is running: focusable, ignores clicks, sets aria-busy and data-loading.

props.name: type
props.description: The native button type. Defaults to button so a Button inside a form does not submit it.

props.name: render
props.description: Base UI render prop: render another element (a link) with the button's props and behaviour.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The button; data-slot="button", data-appearance and data-size name its look (the Fluent names, also when an alias was passed).

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer over the button: the appearance's hover fill, edge or text (subtle turns its icon to the accent).

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus: Fluent's double ring, ring.color outside ring.inner-color (@/lib/control focusRing).

states.name: disabled
states.description: Ignores interaction: color.bg.disabled and color.border.disabled on filled appearances, color.fg.disabled text.

states.name: loading
states.description: Running: aria-busy, ignores clicks, stays focusable, shown as disabled (as Fluent's disabledFocusable).

accessibility: Renders a native <button> with type="button" unless type is set, so Enter and Space activate it.
An icon-only button needs aria-label (use IconButton, whose type requires it).
Disabled uses the native disabled attribute; loading keeps the button focusable (aria-disabled) so focus is not lost mid-action, and sets aria-busy.

The focus ring shows for keyboard focus only (focus-visible): an outline in color.ring, which forced-colours mode keeps, around an inner stroke in color.ring-inner; color.ring meets 3:1 on every surface and layer (token pairs).
Text and fill pairs of every appearance are contrast-checked by the token build in light and dark; disabled text is exempt (WCAG 1.4.3).
